description: Sports records: football fixtures, results and published tables (football-data.org v4), historical matches and lineups (StatsBomb open data), community fixtures and results (openfootball), and tennis match results (Jeff Sackmann's archives, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, non-commercial only). Every correction, forfeit, award or annulment is a revision; nothing is inferred and no odds, tips or predictions are acquired. Source audit: docs/development/sports-evidence/source-audit.md.

defaults.update_cadence: daily during a season; pinned repository releases change only when re-pinned
defaults.temporal_semantics: the source's own publication time (lastUpdated, HTTP Date or the pinned commit date) as publication time and the kickoff as valid time; retrieval time recorded separately

sources.scope: football-data.org v4 matches for the SP01-bounded competition and season (PL/matches?season=2025); odds and referee blocks are dropped at parse time

license.redistribution: non-commercial use with attribution 'Football data provided by the Football-Data.org API' (verify against the live terms)

sports.attribution: Football data provided by the Football-Data.org API
